contractEnforcements.engineerBriefScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-engineer-brief.js consumes ONLY a D3-authoritative HypothesisSet PLUS a D4-authoritative PrioritySet snapshot validated via PRODUCER ATTESTATION across two layers: (a) HE.verifyAuthoritativeHypothesisSet (D3 closure-private WeakSet identity attestation); (b) PE.verifyAuthoritativePrioritySet (D4 closure-private WeakSet identity attestation, exposed at D5-branch as a sibling D3→D4 producer attestation upgrade); (c) cross-binding: prioritySet.sourceHypothesisSetId === hypothesisSet.hypothesisSetId AND prioritySet.sourceGraphId === hypothesisSet.sourceGraphId (the D4 output MUST have been derived from the D3 input); (d) identity binding: caseAssociation + sessionAssociation match between D3 and D4. Layered model: (e) input root frozen via captured Object.isFrozen; (f) descriptor-only input snapshot — rejects Symbol-keyed / non-enumerable / accessor / function fields on input wrapper; (g) opts descriptor snapshot — rejects unknown own keys; (h) mandatory freshness reference time (opts.clock() OR opts.referenceNowMs; clock invoked AT MOST ONCE post-authority); (i) freshness check vs hs.createdAt and ps.createdAt against opts.maxAgeMs; (j) brief composition by re-projection (NO recomputation of confidence / credibility / priority / eligibility); (k) D1 engineer-brief-contract.validateEngineerBriefShape final structural gate (mandatory-presence keys: contradictions, alternativeExplanations, cannotConcludeReasonCodes, limitations — omission triggers BRIEF_CONTRADICTION_HIDDEN / BRIEF_CANNOT_CONCLUDE_HIDDEN / BRIEF_LIMITATION_HIDDEN); (l) deep-frozen envelope registered in D5's closure-private WeakSet via captured Reflect.apply on captured WeakSet.prototype.{add,has}.
contractEnforcements.viewmodelScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-engineer-viewmodel.js consumes ONLY a D5-authoritative Engineer Brief envelope validated via EB.verifyAuthoritativeEngineerBrief. Re-projection ONLY: NO recomputation of confidence / credibility / priority / eligibility / contradiction status. Output is deep-frozen + registered in a closure-private WeakSet via captured Reflect.apply. Public surface: { buildEngineerViewModel, buildBlockedViewModel, verifyAuthoritativeEngineerViewModel, DISPLAY_STATE_ALLOWED }. NO register/sign/secret/registry exports. Display states (closed enum): unavailable / blocked / loading / available / inconclusive / stale-cleared / error-sanitized.
contractEnforcements.orchestratorScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-engineer-orchestrator.js maintains module-scoped current state (envelope + viewModel + caseAssociation + generationToken + monotonic seq). Stale-async drop: if internalSeq advances during prepareEngineerInsight, the result is dropped and not published. Invalidation reasons (closed enum, 13 entries): case_changed / session_changed / evidence_graph_changed / hypothesis_set_changed / priority_set_changed / mapping_changed / calibration_changed / telemetry_replaced / case_archived / case_deleted / imported_summary_opened / generation_token_changed / application_restart. Subscriber snapshots are non-authoritative deep-frozen plain objects — callers CANNOT spoof producer attestation via the snapshot. Authoritative reference accessible only via getCurrentAuthoritativeEnvelope / getCurrentAuthoritativeViewModel (host wiring).
contractEnforcements.uiScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-engineer-ui.js is RENDER-ONLY. Pure-DOM construction (NO innerHTML, NO arbitrary string parsing). i18n keys ONLY — no localized strings constructed inside the UI. Forbidden phrases (directive §13.3, audited in tests): confirmed_cause / definitive_diagnosis / driver_fault / driver_error / guaranteed_improvement / fastest_setup / optimal_setup / theoretical_best / ai_diagnosis. Mount is idempotent and stateless.
contractEnforcements.featureRegistryActivation: feature-registry.js registers (a) NAV_NODES['case:engineer_brief'] case subview labelKey casenav.engineer_brief order 8; (b) FEATURES.engineer_brief area=case_scoped navNodeId='case:engineer_brief' paneId='analysis' availability='available_conditional'. uiAllowed transitions to true; featureRegistryActivationAllowed transitions to true. R3.0B portable schema UNTOUCHED.
contractEnforcements.stateInvalidation: Orchestrator invalidate() bumps internalSeq + clears authoritative envelope+viewModel + publishes a stale-cleared subscriber snapshot. Stale async callbacks are DROPPED. Generation-token mismatch is treated as stale. Listener errors are SWALLOWED (do not propagate; do not block other listeners).
contractEnforcements.privacyInvariants: ViewModel + UI surface MUST NOT contain raw telemetry samples, file paths, machine IDs, or stack traces. Reason codes + i18n keys ONLY. Audited in tests/r3.0d-engineer-brief.test.js Section K and tests/r3.0d-engineer-viewmodel.test.js Section E.
contractEnforcements.noLLM: Deterministic. No LLM call. No runtime config.
contractEnforcements.noAutoMode: D5 emits descriptive engineer brief + viewmodel only. NO apply_mode field. NO auto_tuning / auto_setup / auto_calibration / auto_preset.
contractEnforcements.hardenedIntrinsicsEnforced: All ambient calls go through HI. Module-init captures: Object.isFrozen, Date.parse, Object.is, WeakSet/WeakSet.prototype.{add,has}, Reflect.apply. No ambient .every / .forEach / .push / Object.freeze / Array.isArray / JSON.stringify outside HI namespace — audited per-module via tests Section P / F.
contractEnforcements.outerTryCatch: buildEngineerBrief + buildEngineerViewModel + buildBlockedViewModel + prepareEngineerInsight + invalidate are wrapped in outer try/catch → sanitized error result on any uncaught throw.
